object.name: evi_biquad_coeff
object.digest: Audio rate biquad coefficients calculator with selection of 40 different filter types.
object.description: evi.biquadcoeff~ is an audio rate coefficients calculator for the <o>biquad~</o> (or <o>evi.biquad~</o>) object. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: Cutoff in Hz (default) or Pitch (change units with 'cutoffunits' attribute).

inlets.name: gain
inlets.digest: Gain in dB (default) or linear value (change units with 'gainunits' attribute).

inlets.name: q
inlets.digest: Q of currently selected filter type, typically clamped 0.1..18, but some filter types can take much higher values (e.g. 'reson' or 'bp')

attributes.name: cutoffunits
attributes.description: Set the units for the cutoff frequency inlet (inlet 1). 0 = in Hz (default), 1 = in Pitch (e.g. 0..127).

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Set the filter type by integer index: 0=bypass, 1=lowpass, 2=highpass, 3=bandpass, 4=bandstop, 5=peaknotch, 6=lowshelf, 7=lowshelfcookbook, 8=highshelf, 9=highshelfcookbook, 10=resonant, 11=bp, 12=allpass, 13=gainlpass, 14=gainhpass, 15=gainbpass, 16=gainbstop, 17=gainresonant, 18=gainbp, 19=gainapass, 20=lowpassanalog1, 21=lowpassanalog2, 22=highpassanalog, 23=bandpassanalog, 24=gainbpassanalog, 25=notchanalog, 26=peaknotchanalog1, 27=peaknotchanalog2, 28=lowshelfanalog1, 29=lowshelfanalog2, 30=highshelfanalog1, 31=highshelfanalog2, 32=resonantanalog, 33=butterlowpass, 34=butterhighpass, 35=butterbandpass, 36=butterbandreject, 37=buttergainlpass, 38=buttergainhpass, 39=buttergainbpass, 40=buttergainbreject

attributes.name: gainunits
attributes.description: Set the units for the gain inlet (inlet 2). 0 = in linear amplitude, 1 = in dB (the default).
